diagnosis: Pattern across re-runs #2/#3/#4/#5: a weak model's first post-resume turn escapes through ANY meta channel still offered. Per-channel refusal gates converge one tool at a time; the structural fix is action-space shaping: withhold the channel entirely.
fix: engine.py _tools_for_step: until the session's first real (non-bookkeeping) action, ALL virtuals except finish are withheld from the offered tool set (ask_user, propose_plan_update, notify_user, remember, serve). finish stays - verify-on-finish gates it. PLANNING mode exempt.

engine.py fresh-session backstop before the propose_plan_update/ask_user gates: hallucinated calls to the withheld ask_user/propose_plan_update get an ENVIRONMENT refusal message + _invisible_steps increment + valve check, then continue (non-blocking).
